question: May CodexBar import and forward the complete `longcat.chat` cookie jar to LongCat’s same-origin usage endpoints when the provider is disabled by default, Chrome-only in Auto mode, and avoids logging sensitive response bodies?
rationale: The precise Meituan authentication cookie is undocumented, so code inspection cannot determine whether domain-wide cookie forwarding is an acceptable permanent provider contract.

options.title: Accept guarded full-cookie access
options.body: Approve the same-origin full-cookie design after the correctness fixes and redacted live proof, retaining disabled-by-default, source gating, isolated transport, and no-sensitive-body logging.

options.title: Require a narrow credential
options.body: Pause the provider until LongCat documents a specific authentication cookie, usage token, or supported usage API that avoids handling the complete cookie jar.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded full-cookie access
recommendation.body: Approve the same-origin full-cookie design after the correctness fixes and redacted live proof, retaining disabled-by-default, source gating, isolated transport, and no-sensitive-body logging.
